source: Open items from the Q4 Playbook, the Sep 25 weekly meeting, and the research sweep of Notion, Drive and Gmail (Sep 27 2026).

items.title: Read access to Instagram Insights for all three accounts
items.detail: Meta Business Suite access for @prometrausa, the METO Movement account and @dromavi. Without it the views, watch time and follower numbers on this report stay empty.

items.title: Approve the monthly boost caps
items.detail: $100 a month on the METO Movement account, $100 on @dromavi, and $0 on @prometrausa. That is $850 planned from Sep 28 to Dec 31, and every boost still has to earn 10 MOVEMENT comments first.

items.title: Decide who presses Boost
items.detail: Either Dr. Omavi boosts from his own ad account when the Friday note says a post cleared the gate, or Venelt runs Ads Manager with a card and the caps in writing.

items.title: The METO Movement account's handle
items.detail: The handle is not written down anywhere yet. We need it to track the account and to set up the ad audiences.

items.title: Friday counts: sign-ups, applications and seats
items.detail: Curriculum sign-ups from Teachable or the METO app, pilgrimage applications from the metomovement.com form, and confirmed seats. One message every Friday is enough.

items.title: Confirm the ManyChat MOVEMENT flow is live
items.detail: Sources disagree on whether ManyChat is on a paid plan. The MOVEMENT keyword only sends the course link by DM when the flow is live, and it is what we count for the boost gate.

items.title: Yes or no on two pieces waiting on you
items.detail: How to Draw the Star (filming Oct 5 only if you say yes on Sep 28) and the DNA piece, 'Where I'm From'.

items.title: 12 modules or 13?
items.detail: The site and the course plan say 12. The app shows 13 module films. Ads and captions will use whichever number you confirm.
